maya: Quick heads-up — cutoff for v0.23.0 is in ~6h. Please confirm version bump PR, changelog entries, and QA owners. @sam @linda @jen
sam: On it. PR #482 is ready, just waiting on one last CR. I'll ping reviewers.
linda: Docs update drafted in docs PR, still need the changelog line. I'll push in ~30m.
jen (QA): I can own smoke — staging + canary? Any special checks?
maya: staging + canary. Smoke checklist: login flow, embed/serve latency, a quick rerank sanity check. Keep an eye on tail latencies.
sam: For version bump I'll use: `chore(release): 0.23.0` then tag `v0.23.0`. Plan to squash-merge after signoffs.
sam: pushing a tiny fix for model-pin fallback under low memory pressure — will rebase PR.
security-bot: Security scan: 1 low-sev dev dependency flagged (dev only). No blocker for release.
linda: Changelog entry added: "optimize: reduce KV cache memory usage under long sessions" — pushed to docs PR.
jen (QA): kicking off smoke now on staging. Will post failures inline.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated for release-0.23 -> us-west-2 (canary-1). Dashboard: https://deploys.example.com/release-0.23/canary-1
jordan: Heads-up — noticed flaky `integration/long-session` in CI. I disabled it temporarily to avoid blocking the cut, will open a follow-up to re-enable and investigate.
maya: Ok need explicit signoffs: @sam (eng/bump), @jen (QA), @security-bot (sec). Any objections?
sam: Eng signoff ✅ — PR merged and branch bumped locally.
jen (QA): Staging smoke passed. Canary at 10m looks stable. No regressions observed. ✅
security-bot: Security review signoff ✅
maya: Thanks — cutting release in ~15m unless CI alerts. Tagging shortly.
sam: Tag pushed `v0.23.0` and changelog updated on main.
maya: Release cut done. Pushing release notes and opening post-release followups for flaky test and doc redirects.
jen (QA): I'll add a short runbook note in the ticket in case we need to triage perf regressions.
linda: Docs published, changelog anchor added and redirects verified.
maya: :tada: Excellent work everyone. I'll close the release checklist and move the remaining items to the v0.23.x board.
